decisions.name: Bolton Canoe Access Area
decisions.rationale: ANR feature OBJECTID 1061 explicitly identifies a public Winooski canoe-access area. The adopted 2025 Bolton Town Plan says ANR and the Town maintain Bolton Canoe Access on the Winooski, and Richmond places it about four miles west on River Road from Bolton Dam. The former pin reverse-geocodes to an address on Bolton Valley Access Road and does not fit that description. ANR does not publish the exact water-entry toe, so the replacement is documented as an access-area anchor.

postCorrectionAudit.reviewReason: Both refreshed audits match the exact ANR access-area feature and classify it as review, which preserves the distinction between an official access anchor and an unsurveyed wet edge.

withheldRoute.siteOccurrence: The corrected Bolton endpoint is review with no source issue or unknown result.
withheldRoute.otherFailure: Its Floodplain Preserve take-out still fails at 8,452 feet from Winooski River, nearest Johnnie Brook; keep the pre-existing route hold.

decisions.reopenWhen: Recheck if Vermont ANR relocates or replaces RECSITES feature OBJECTID 1061, or if the Town/ANR publishes a georeferenced ramp or wet-edge coordinate.
